Will only update units health in the board and never show camera transitions to the battle arenas;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b](NEW) STATUS EFFECTS[/b][/h2][p]Well, we had status effects before (Amara's Special Slow down), but now they are a full fledged system![/p][p][/p][h3][b](UPDATED) SLOW DOWN[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/202e97d435d7576ba63790c953b028c559623571.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Status: [b]SLOW DOWN[/b][/p][list][*][p]Any units with [b]SLOW DOWN[/b] will have it's [b]movement range reduced by 2[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]Units with [b]SLOW DOWN[/b] have a blue arrow pointing down on them;[/p][/*][*][p]Minimum movement range will be [b]1 [/b](so units like Sniper (Movement Range 2) won't be fully rooted);[/p][/*][*][p][b]MAGNETs[/b] cannot receive [b]SLOW DOWN, [/b]not even by Amara's Special[b];[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]SLOW DOWN[/b] can be given to enemies through:[/p][list][*][p]Amara's Special (lasts 1 turn);[/p][/*][*][p]If you are adjacent to a enemy [b]MAGNET[/b]. [/p][/*][*][p]Cannot be stacked;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]SLOW DOWN [/b]can be removed if:[/p][list][*][p][b]MAGNET [/b]unit is destroyed;[/p][/*][*][p]You move away from the [b]MAGNET[/b] area;[/p][/*][*][p](If Amara Special) After the turn ends;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](NEW) BURN[/b][/h3][p][img notes.title: Demo 1.0.9 Out now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, [b]Danilo[/b] here, creator of [b]Avante! Atlantis, [/b]and here are the 1.0.9 Update for the demo![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]DEMO 1.0.9[/h1][h1]MAJOR UPDATES[/h1][hr][/hr][h2]NEW UNIT: DRILL[/h2][p][/p][p]Movement Range: [b]4[/b][/p][p]Movement Restrictions: [b]Water, Bridges[/b][/p][p]Description: Drill unit is a Medium Armor / Light Weapon unit. It digs through the ground, making all movement costs 1, different from other units. It also can ignore enemy units as a blocking area, allowing for versatile repositioning;[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/86605b1f4ebe01249d430b917dd6ff18185ba827.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]NEW MAP: I DIG THAT![/h2][p]
As we added the Drill unit, comes with a new map: [b]I Dig That![/b][/p][p]Use it to check better how the drill unit works.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/4efa3dc744311725e4138abca2e753e79b1064fd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]NEW MAP: ECONOMY CLASS[/h2][p][/p][p]We've run a voting in our discord, and lots of people were asking for [b]bigger maps.[/b][/p][p]So with that, introducing our biggest map yet, a massing 19x19 Deployment Map: Economy Class![/p][p][/p][p]This map expects longer battles and more strategist decisions! You will spend a lot of money on this one.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/727b97a8bfc4d0ac1b08b88cda866f392ad964bc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]NEW STRATEGIST REVEALED: INGRID FALK[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/37f6a0da31539e9b9106cd8d98d5bde23000ded1.png"][/img]The Prodigy Detective (and a super stylish goth) from the Obsidian Ravens: [b]Ingrid Falk[/b][/p][p]Ingrid is a forensic prodigy who treats the battlefield like a crime scene: methodical, silent, and unnervingly precise. While others lead with force, she leads with deduction, always a step ahead.[/p][p]Cold and analytical, she keeps everyone at a distance. Her goal is simple: uncover the truth behind the rise of Atlantis.[/p][p] 
More info about her in the [b]Gallery![/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Global Stats[/h2][p]
Some global Stats are now available for everyone to check in the main menu. Check if your main is winning! (And if not, start playing!)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/3f6798640a14fce7a43f6504c90ef2b60f23de34.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]BALANCING[/h2][list][*][p]Reduced [b]HOVER[/b] unit movement range [b]6→4[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced [b]ARTILLERY[/b] and [b]MISSILES[/b] movement range from [b]5→4[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]CREATE YOUR OWN MAP[/h2][p][/p][p]We are hosting a small competition on your discord server. Create your own map for the game!

The winner will get:[/p][list][*][p]The Name in the Credits;[/p][/*][*][p]The map in-game and playable for everyone (with an extra credit on the map selection 🙂 )[/p][/*][*][p]1 Key for the Full Game;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Check our discord [url="https://discord.gg/y8c4HgsV" style="button"]#announcements[/url] channel for more informations![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Small Updates & Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Gallery Updates: [b]Ingrid Falk[/b] and [b]Crystal Wolfs[/b] revealed! Also, experiment clicking on the ruined Avante! Atlantis logo in the last entry...there's a special thing waiting for you![/p][/*][*][p][b]Reiko Special changed[/b]: Instead of removing camps from the opponent, [b]now it captures Empty Camps only. [/b]This can be very strong early game, but later game needs more strategic position to use it's full power![/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed UI for buying new units[/b] sometimes clipping outside the screen;[/p][/*][*][p][b]ESC [/b]can now be used to return in the main menu;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mirage on Desert[/b] map got a small rework;[/p][/*][*][p]Tried a fix for [b]Main menu disappearing[/b] (specifically from the Main Menu to the Battle Chose!);[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed Dice Box Collision[/b] to be thicker, trying to avoid dice rolling out of the box;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Special's Not showing the Strategist Image[/b]![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]
Future Updates in Development:[/h2][list][*][p]Story Mode (Prologue);[/p][/*][*][p]New Units: Magnet, Transport, Ballistic, Mega;[/p][/*][*][p]New Maps;[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fixing;[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing;[/p][/*][*][p]Map Creator;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And that's all for now!
Thanks, and [i][b]Avante![/b]i[/i][/p]

[p]Hello everyone, [b]Danilo[/b] here, creator of [b]Avante! Atlantis[/b][/p][p][/p][p]First of all, I'd like to thank everyone who played the demo, for all the feedback and love sent.
I've been developing [b]Avante! Atlantis solo[/b] for about [b]1 year[/b] now. When I mean solo, I mean [b]I do 90% of the project, while the others 10% I have help[/b] from friends and freelancers, so I want to publicly thank all the people who have helped me:[/p][list][*][p]Luiz Carlos de Gino for stylized [b]Character Designs[/b];[/p][list][*][p]Leo Ross for helping with [b]Character Emotions (Not yet in game!)[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Roberta B. notes.title: New Demo Announcement + Remove of the old Demo
Avante! Atlantis Updates! World Map, Defined Units and Commanders
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Just wanted to keep you updated on how development on Avante! Atlantis is going.

During January, I've been researching and trying to set up in stone some things.

And here are they:

- I'll do my best to finish the game [b]without[/b] story mode by the end of this year;
- There will be Multiplayer Local and Online, plus Single Player (Player vs Computer);
- Ideally we will have a map creator, but I'm leaving that for last;
- There will be a total of 8 Commanders, based on 8 Nations (which are Work in Progress);
- There will be a total of 20 Units. Naval and Air Units were removed due time constrains (but nothing stops me to add them in a later update or DLC);


On the World:
- There will be 8 teams/nations: Ruby Jaguars, Garnet Eagles, Jade Foxes, Opal Sharks, Sapphire Lions, 
Amethyst Tigers, Spinel Cobras and Obsidian Ravens;
- Here's a world map of the game. This will be more used on the Story Mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/a793b0842c5ce2f1cf4a2a62dd0974d5c873e97b.png[/img]

On the Commanders:
- I'm still writing them, but we already have 1 totally defined and with art!

Meet Thaddeus Armstrong, General of the Army of the Garnet Eagles!
Ruthless, he will do anything to achieve his goal!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/179064fb0b453447130ced97424916f5dfde5885.png[/img]

On the Units:
- There game will feature this units, and this is the damage/defense chart of it, where: Dark Red is Useless, Red is Worst, Oragen is Bad, Yellow is Moderated (50%+-), Green is Good, Blue is Awesome and Pink is Overkill against it.
- Some of this arts are Placeholders, so don't worry about it
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/0b701329cf42ca2747f3e95e48e0646d06b041a5.png[/img]

Here are the currently ones with almost/or already finished art:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/f2a726fdf9ca254d670a7f9f1760a54ca0803db1.png[/img]

And I think that's it for now. Development is going well, some people are helping me with some areas, so hopefully it all goes smooth!

Thanks, and [b]Avante[/b]!
